prompt: A close-up, detailed view of an old-fashioned watchmaker's desk. The wooden surface is scattered with delicate tools. A jeweler's loupe rests beside a disassembled pocket watch case. A tray holds tiny screws and a collection of brass gears. A pair of fine-tipped tweezers is positioned next to a mainspring. A small oiler and a cleaning brush are neatly arranged. A workbench lamp with a green shade casts a pool of light. A small, leather-bound manual on horology is open to a diagram. An empty watch stand and a polishing cloth complete the scene. This is a place of mechanical precision, not heavy industry, so there is no large hammer or anvil. The focus is on timepieces, so you will not see a large wall clock, and modern gadgets like a smartphone or a digital caliper are absent.
